rework.summary: Stored fields are unchanged in meaning (judgeAccredited, judgeOrganisation, judgeAvailable, judgeDate, judgeCommunication, judgeForum, dietary) plus one new stored key dietaryOther. The form asks fewer, merged questions and the client maps controls to those stored fields; the server enforces the same canonical combinations. No gating on accreditation (lead ruling 16 Nov): availability, Communication and Forum are asked of everyone.

rework.openForLeeAnn: Membership combinations other than None-exclusive (Overseas visitor with a South African society, society member with Independent Member). No rule is encoded; validation-cases pins that those combinations stay valid until she answers.

validationRules.email: trimmed, at most 254 chars, one @, local part at most 64 chars with no leading, trailing or doubled dots and no spaces, domain labels of letters, digits and inner hyphens separated by single dots, final label letters only and at least 2 long
validationRules.mobile: allowed characters digits, spaces, hyphens, round brackets and a leading plus; at most 30 characters. After stripping spaces, hyphens and brackets it must be (a) '+' or '00' then country code and number of 8 to 15 digits in total, first digit not 0; when the country code is 27 the number is exactly 9 digits and does not start with 0; or (b) South African local format: '0' then exactly 9 digits (10 digits in all). Anything else, including no country code and '+27 (0)82...', is rejected
validationRules.names: first name, surname, preferred name: required after trimming, at most 100 characters
validationRules.dietaryOther: required (trimmed, 1 to 100 chars) iff dietary is Other, otherwise must be empty/absent and is stored as null
